company_name: Zhejiang Jingsheng Mechanical & Electrical Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in semiconductor equipment manufacturing and R&D, particularly in crystal growing and wafer production.
summary: Zhejiang Jingsheng Mechanical & Electrical Co., Ltd. is a high-tech enterprise focused on the R&D and manufacturing of equipment for the semiconductor and photovoltaic material industries. They produce advanced crystal growing furnaces and high-quality SiC wafers, catering to the needs of the semiconductor market.

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Shangyu, Shaoxing City, Zhejiang Province, and has a strong presence in the domestic semiconductor equipment market.
